Preschool Story Time (Ages 3–5)
cases.description: Preschoolers and a grown-up join a librarian for picture books, songs, and a movement game. Free; just drop in.

cases.title: Baby Bookworms (Ages 0–24 months)
cases.description: A short lap-sit program for babies and caregivers with bounces, board books, and rhymes.

cases.title: Halloween Family Movies: Halloweentown (1998) (G)
cases.description: A family screening of a G-rated Halloween movie in the event center. Costumes welcome; popcorn provided.

cases.title: Teen Cuisine: Rainbow Cookies (Grades 5–12)
cases.description: Teens bake and decorate layered cookies with library staff. Registration required; ingredients provided.

cases.title: ESL for Beginner, Intermediate & Advanced Levels
cases.description: Adults practice English conversation and grammar in small groups led by volunteer tutors. Free.

cases.title: Equipping Your Nonprofit Board for Success
cases.description: A workshop for nonprofit leaders on recruiting board members and running effective meetings.

cases.title: Banned Books Read-In
cases.description: Community members read short passages from challenged books aloud. Everyone is welcome to listen or read.

cases.title: Fall Developers Forum
cases.description: City planning staff brief local developers and builders on permitting updates and upcoming projects.

cases.title: Ghost Walks
cases.description: A guided evening walk through downtown Rogers with stories of local history and legends. Tickets required.

cases.title: Movies in the Park
cases.description: A free outdoor movie on the lawn. Bring blankets or chairs; the film starts at dusk.

cases.title: Christmas Parade
cases.description: The annual holiday parade with floats, bands, and Santa, ending at the downtown square.

cases.title: Blood Drive
cases.description: Donors can give blood at a mobile collection site. Appointments are encouraged; walk-ins accepted.

cases.title: Shred It and Electronics Recycling
cases.description: Residents bring personal papers to be shredded and old electronics to be recycled at no cost.

cases.title: National Night Out
cases.description: Neighbors meet local police and firefighters with food, games, and safety demonstrations.
